data.narrative: The student successfully implemented an integration-heavy testing strategy using pytest, covering critical user journeys including link creation, redirection, auth protection, IDOR owner scoping, retention purging, and URL validation. They demonstrated strong debugging methodology by isolating and fixing test state pollution flakiness using automatic test fixtures.

dimension_scores.observation: Chose an integration-heavy testing strategy to ensure end-to-end reliability and avoid false confidence from mocks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option B to verify actual system boundaries against isolated test instances.

dimension_scores.observation: Successfully reproduced and fixed a test flakiness bug caused by shared state pollution by introducing state-clearing fixtures.
dimension_scores.evidence: Removed fixture cleanup, observed test failure from shared state, restored state isolation, and verified deterministic passes.

dimension_scores.observation: Covered security boundaries in tests including IDOR owner scoping, authentication protection, and URL injection bypass rejection.
dimension_scores.evidence: Added explicit test cases verifying 401 unauthenticated access, 404 IDOR owner isolation, and Pydantic URL validation rejection.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced test determinism and isolation rules to prevent real database leakage and cross-test state pollution.
dimension_scores.evidence: Utilized autouse test fixtures to reset in-memory stores between runs.

dimension_scores.observation: Articulated the risks of flaky tests, the value of integration testing, and the dangers of hitting production databases.
dimension_scores.evidence: Answered verification questions detailing how flaky tests destroy team trust and why test isolation is critical.

data.recommendation: Integrate code coverage measurement and automated test execution into your CI/CD pipeline in the upcoming modules.
